verses.1: After these things, the words of Jehovah were spoken to Abraham through the angel. He said, “Do not fear, Abraham! I will protect you. Your reward will be great.”
verses.2: And Abraham said, “Lord Yehovah, what will You give me? I am poor and destitute. My house is in ruins; it’s a place of destruction.”
verses.3: And Abraham said, “You have not given me any seed. And now, a son from my household is coming to inherit me.”
verses.4: And behold, the word of Jehovah was to him: “You shall not inherit it, for whoever comes from among you will inherit it.”
verses.5: And he took him out of the tent. Then he said, “Please count the stars in the sky. Can you count them?” He replied, “That will be your offspring.”
verses.6: And he believed in Jehovah, and he considered it to be right.
verses.7: And He said to him, “I am Jehovah, who have brought you out of the land of Egypt to give you this land for your inheritance.”
verses.8: And Adonai said, “In the wilderness, I will know.”
verses.9: And he said to him, “Take for me a lamb of six years old, and a goat of six years old, and two lambs of six years old, and also a dove and an eagle.”
verses.10: And he took all these things and buried them in the tomb. He gave one of them to his enemy as a warning, but he did not give the other one to him.
verses.11: And the vulture descended upon the corpses and settled them in place.
verses.12: And the sun came out, and its rays fell upon Abraham. Then, a great fear overwhelmed him.
verses.13: And he said to Abraham, “Know that your descendants will not be able to live in this land. They will be enslaved by them, and they will oppress them for four generations.”
verses.14: And also, those nations who will serve me will be blessed greatly. After that, they will go forth with great joy.
verses.15: And you shall come before your fathers, and you shall rest in a good place.
verses.16: And the fourth generation will return, for the sins of the Amorites have not yet been forgiven.
verses.17: And the sun came out, and it shone brightly. Then, there appeared a column of smoke, and flames rushed through among these trees.
verses.18: On that day, Jehovah destroyed Abraham. He made a covenant with him, saying, “To your descendants I give this land, from the river of Egypt to the great river, the River Euphrates.”
verses.19: The Kenites, the Kenezim, and the Kadmonim.
verses.20: And the midwives, and the practitioners, and the healers.
verses.21: And the Amorites, and the Canaanites, and the Hagarites, and the Yebusites.
